title: GAVIN · SHEET 2 / 3: MOVE 2 (The La Fière Causeway) · locked style + locked sounds
note: Every shell / bazooka impact shakes the screen (default shake, no overrides; grep 'shake' scenes-src = none). No zoom sound in this move (badges silent).
frames: MOVE 2 title card: THE LA FIÈRE CAUSEWAY · 6-9 JUNE 1944
Night drop over the Cotentin; Gavin (brig. gen.) lands west of the flooded Merderet; badge
Mission: hold the Merderet crossings so Utah Beach can push west and cut the peninsula
La Fière close-up: flooded valley, the ~500-yard causeway, manor + bridge, Cauquigny chapel
6-8 June: paratroopers hold the manor; captured French tanks come down the causeway; two-colour front
Tank fire: boom + SHAKE on impact
Bazookas knock the tanks out on the road; Lt. John Dolan: no better place to die (paraphrase)
Boom + SHAKE on every bazooka hit
German MG fields of fire cover every yard of the causeway
Gavin saw something different: SPEED IS THE ONLY COVER
The tools: glider infantry battalion + 155 mm guns from Utah Beach
9 June 10:45: 15 minutes of shelling on the far bank
Launch thud, boom + SHAKE on every shell
Thin smoke; the glider infantry go to ground halfway; some turn back
Gavin to Capt. Rae: “All right, you've got to go.” (verbatim, quote marks)
Rae's ~90 men charge; Gavin and Ridgway out on the road under fire
Across: Cauquigny falls, front line jumps west, German ground fades
THE CAUSEWAY IS OPEN: fresh troops cross
Casualty card: 82nd ~60 killed, 500+ wounded/captured/missing (6-9 June); German unknown
Method card, lines 1-2 lit: TAKE THE GROUND THAT DECIDES THE BATTLE
